businesses.business: for-profit online and hybrid higher education

offering_description.value: Operates University of Phoenix, a primarily online university offering degree programs to working adult students. Delivers instruction through online and some on-campus/hybrid formats, with tuition largely funded by federal aid, employers and personal funds.

primary_services.value: online degree programs; certificate programs; continuing education; employer-partnered workforce training

customer_segment.value: B2C: working adult students seeking associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees; B2B: employers and corporate partners sponsoring employee education; B2G: military and government-affiliated students and agencies

end_markets.value: higher education; adult and professional education; workforce development; healthcare, business and technology education

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees for degree and certificate programs, largely funded by federal aid, employers and students

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers accredited instruction to adult students, mainly online, using its own faculty and curriculum

geography_served.value: US national: students across the United States, primarily online, with some campuses and learning centers

specialization.value: related lines: degree programs across business, healthcare, technology, education and behavioral sciences for adult learners

distribution_channels.value: online: online classrooms and digital enrollment and marketing; own locations: campuses and learning centers; partners / resellers: employer and corporate partnerships

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Title IV federal student aid eligibility, Department of Education rules, accreditation (HLC), state authorization, and VA/DoD rules
